scene.ofreeRecent: A private covered gallery with latticework looking onto a dock — She sits to enjoy the orange candies she made as a gift; An open-sided boat landing where a small ferry waits under the long roof — Lu Ji takes a break from her journey and shares the citrus she brought; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — carries her keepsake low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her front; A passenger terminal’s private rehearsal room with a curved viewport — A dawn departure celebration is about to start; a wooden river dock above calm water — standing with one foot up on a step; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a book closed against her chest; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her left side; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an underground subway platform — carries a camera by its grip at her side

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the female personification of Cao Rui of the Three Kingdoms, seen in her everyday life. Her Three Kingdoms identity shows ONLY as a small accessory, an object around her, or the object PROP says she holds — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume.

DESIGN (accessory hints only): her legend — sharp judgment and a love of grand palaces, imperial robes heavy with ornament — may inform at most one small accessory, a hair ornament or an object beside her, in its palette (deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white). The clothes keep the chosen outfit's own colours; her skin, hair and eyes stay as in the attached image.

OBJECTS: any identity accessory or object, including the one PROP names, takes a present-day form that fits this place — a charm, a hairpin, a phone strap, a modern cup or bottle; no Chinese antique objects such as jade carvings, porcelain wine cups, bronze vessels or paper lanterns.

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

Place: An open pavilion beside a public garden, with a table in quiet morning light.
Activity: She looks up from a folded paper model of an imperial roof and shows it to the viewer with a small, satisfied smile.
Pose: Seated facing the viewer, she cradles the little paper roof in her left hand and rests her open right hand on the near tabletop.
Framing: An eye-level waist-up portrait from the other side of the table, her face and both hands in the light.
Time of day (fixed): warm lamplight or candlelight indoors, the rest in shadow — set your scene at this time.

skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.
